QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Western Castle Situation
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bEdea#k in the #bDowntown Black Market#k.
QuestInfo.1: Edea isn't sure if the guardian of the west of the castle still remains. She wants you to go to #bWorkshop 2nd Floor in the west of the castle#k and survey the #renemies#k.
QuestInfo.2: When you reported that Victor's creation was in the west of the castle, Edea had many questions. As far as she knew, Victor was already dead...
